title: Skills Are Magic Spells
goal: A skill is a special trick the robot can learn.
mascot_lines: A slash command is a little shortcut you can save and reuse.
Type a slash, then a name, and the helper runs your saved spell.
Each spell does one job, like a kitchen tool that does one thing well.
We can even make our own spells for stuff we do all the time.

tier2.rephrase: Each spell starts with a / and does a special job. Match them!

tier3.nudge: /draw makes pictures. /save sends to cloud. /loop repeats.
